combinations.evidence_quote: Co-treatment with AT-RvD1 and 3-MA resulted in reduction in LC3BII/LCBI (Figure 5A), whereas concomitant administration of BafA1 and AT-RvD1 did not show a further increase in the LC3B-II/I ratio in the microglia denying the functional route of the lysosomal degradation of AT-RvD1.
